Its location is remarkable: it is inserted between two blocks of theses all of which derive from Recanati seriatim. The source of Conclusio xl, the last of the first block, is Recanati, fol. 65ra. The source of Conclusio xlii, the first of the second block, is Recanati, fol. 75rb.
